statement_en: Let B be a finite set of natural numbers such that no two different subsets of B have the same sum. Show that the sum of the reciprocals of the elements of B is less than 2.
statement_lean:
theorem erdos_52871 (B : Finset ℕ)
    (hsub : ∀ X ⊆ B, ∀ Y ⊆ B, ∑ m ∈ X, m = ∑ m ∈ Y, m → X = Y) :
    ∑ m ∈ B, (1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) < 2 := by
  sorry
